patch_description: Redesigned ansatz builds on the best-performing seed architecture (alternating RY/RZ single-qubit rotations with a bidirectional CNOT ladder, feeding into a CRZ entangling block, then a final global RY). The structural change adds a second parametrized entangling gate type (CRX) immediately after the CRZ block, applied to the same disjoint qubit pairs, but *reuses the exact same parameter name* ("ent") as the CRZ gates. This deliberately shares the trainable parameter between CRZ and CRX so the distinct-parameter count (6) does not increase, while giving the circuit two independent non-commuting two-qubit generators (Z⊗Z-type and X-control-rotation-type) driven by one angle. This boosts entangling expressivity/non-Clifford structure — which prior feedback flagged as beneficial for margin/robustness — without paying the parameter-economy penalty of introducing a new trainable name. The forward/backward CNOT ladders and alternating parity rotations are kept because they gave the best generalization gap and margin so far; only the entangling core is enriched.
